dev_tgt_X = dev_tgt.X.toarray() if hasattr(dev_tgt.X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(dev_tgt.X)

scaler = MaxAbsScaler()
scaler.fit(train_X)
train_scaled = scaler.transform(train_X)
dev_ctrl_scaled = scaler.transform(dev_ctrl_X)
dev_tgt_mean = dev_tgt_X.mean(axis=0)

cell_types = sorted(train.obs['cell_type'].unique())
n_ct = len(cell_types)

ctrl_means = {}
stim_means = {}
for ct in cell_types:
    mask = train.obs['cell_type'] == ct
    ctrl = train_scaled[(mask.values) & (train.obs['condition'] == 'control').values]
    stim = train_scaled[(mask.values) & (train.obs['condition'] == 'stimulated').values]
    ctrl_means[ct] = ctrl.mean(axis=0)
    stim_means[ct] = stim.mean(axis=0)

ctrl_mat = np.stack([ctrl_means[ct] for ct in cell_types])
stim_mat = np.stack([stim_means[ct] for ct in cell_types])
diff_mat = stim_mat - ctrl_mat

dev_mean = dev_ctrl_scaled.mean(axis=0)
nidx = int(np.argmax([np.corrcoef(dev_mean, ctrl_mat[i])[0,1] if np.isfinite(np.corrcoef(dev_mean, ctrl_mat[i])[0,1]) else -1 for i in range(n_ct)]))

nd = diff_mat[nidx]
r_dev = np.clip(np.where(ctrl_mat[nidx] > 1e-8, dev_mean / np.maximum(ctrl_mat[nidx], 1e-8), 1.0), 0.1, 10.0)
scale_ = scaler.scale_

global_up, global_dn = 0.17, 0.80
sd_base = np.where(nd > 0, nd * r_dev**global_up, np.where(nd < 0, nd * r_dev**global_dn, 0))
pred_base = np.clip(dev_mean + sd_base, 0, 1)
pred_base_o = pred_base * scale_
mse_base = np.mean((dev_tgt_mean - np.clip(pred_base_o, 0, None))**2)
print(f'Baseline sign-aware: {mse_base:.8f}')

def loo_bin_sign(n_bins, up_grid, dn_grid):
    mses = []
    bin_size = 2000 // n_bins
    
    for h in range(n_ct):
        rem = [i for i in range(n_ct) if i "'!= h]
        ho = ctrl_mat[h]
        c = [np.corrcoef(ho, ctrl_mat[r])[0,1] if np.isfinite(np.corrcoef(ho, ctrl_mat[r])[0,1]) else -1 for r in rem]
        ni = rem[int(np.argmax(c))]
        
        sorted_g = np.argsort(ctrl_mat[ni])
        bin_up = np.zeros(n_bins)
        bin_dn = np.zeros(n_bins)
        
        for b in range(n_bins):
            start = b * bin_size
            end = start + bin_size if b < n_bins - 1 else 2000
            bidx = sorted_g[start:end]
            
            best = 1e9
            bu = bd = 0
            for up in up_grid:
                for dn in dn_grid:
                    inner_mses = []
                    for ih in rem:
                        inner_rem = [j for j in rem if j != ih]
                        ic = [np.corrcoef(ctrl_mat[ih], ctrl_mat[j])[0,1] if np.isfinite(np.corrcoef(ctrl_mat[ih], ctrl_mat[j])[0,1]) else -1 for j in inner_rem]
                        ini = inner_rem[int(np.argmax(ic))]
                        r = np.clip(np.where(ctrl_mat[ini][bidx] > 1e-8,
                                             ctrl_mat[ih][bidx] / np.maximum(ctrl_mat[ini][bidx], 1e-8), 1.0), 0.1, 10.0)
                        nd_b = diff_mat[ini][bidx]
                        um, dm = nd_b > 0, nd_b < 0
                        sd = np.zeros_like(nd_b)
                        sd[um] = nd_b[um] * (r[um] ** up)
                        sd[dm] = nd_b[dm] * (r[dm] ** dn)
                        pred = np.clip(ctrl_mat[ih][bidx] + sd, 0, 1)
                        pred_o = pred * scale_[bidx]
                        so = stim_mat[ih][bidx] * scale_[bidx]
                        inner_mses.append(np.mean((so - pred_o)**2))
                    m = np.mean(inner_mses)
                    if m < best:
                        best = m
                        bu = up
                        bd = dn
            bin_up[b] = bu
            bin_dn[b] = bd
        
        pred = np.zeros(2000)
        for b in range(n_bins):
            start = b * bin_size
            end = start + bin_size if b < n_bins - 1 else 2000
            bidx = sorted_g[start:end]
            r = np.clip(np.where(ctrl_mat[ni][bidx] > 1e-8,
                                 ho[bidx] / np.maximum(ctrl_mat[ni][bidx], 1e-8), 1.0), 0.1, 10.0)
            nd_b = diff_mat[ni][bidx]
            um, dm = nd_b > 0, nd_b < 0
            sd = np.zeros_like(nd_b)
            sd[um] = nd_b[um] * (r[um] ** bin_up[b])
            sd[dm] = nd_b[dm] * (r[dm] ** bin_dn[b])
            pred[bidx] = ho[bidx] + sd
        
        pred = np.clip(pred, 0, 1)
        pred_o = pred * scale_
        so = stim_mat[h] * scale_
        mses.append(np.mean((so - pred_o)**2))
    
    return np.mean(mses)

up_grid = np.array([0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.17, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30])
dn_grid = np.array([0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.2])

print('"'\\nPer-expression-bin sign-aware LOO:')
for nb in [2, 3, 5, 10]:
    m = loo_bin_sign(nb, up_grid, dn_grid)
    print(f'  n_bins={nb}: {m:.8f}')
